mapping: r in [-1,1] to uint8 round((r+1)*127.5), clip only floating-point overrun; diagonal r=0; three identical grayscale channels; no axes, legend, text or per-person scaling
preprocessing: exact author _transform(224): bicubic resize, center crop, RGB, ToTensor, published channel normalization
timing_scope: observed calls on two inputs, synchronized GPU only; first/warm/repeat separate; excludes loading, preprocessing, transfers and classification; not P95
limitations: 这是FC图像编码的技术可行性检查，没有疼痛预测成绩。图像没有新增模态；CLIP文本分支未使用，不能称脑影像—临床文本对齐。仅2人和一个随机种子，不代表全79质量、随机分布或独立临床验证。
Natural-image pretraining and grayscale FC matrix layout differ; interpolation, quantization and spatial ordering can affect downstream results.
GPU FP32 was deliberately used instead of the author default GPU half-precision load; no claim of bitwise reproduction of the original environment.
Random control uses one fresh complete author constructor seed; no pretrained position parameter copied.
